tvShow.name: Jet Lag: The Game
tvShow.overview: Jet Lag: The Game is a travel competition show where instead of traveling to the competitions, travel is the competition. Each season brings a new game where the world is the board, with players competing against each other, sleep deprivation, flight delays, broken-down cars, and the bizarre challenges they quickly regret having created.

seasons.name: Hide & Seek UK
seasons.overview: This season, Ben, Adam, and Sam bring their classic Hide + Seek format to the UK! Spanning six days and four countries, this game pushes the boys to their limits as they pit classic questions against a revamped Hider Deck. Who will have what it takes to master these brand new cards and stay hidden among the UK’s cities, rolling fields, and cliffside beaches?

seasons.name: Japanorama
seasons.overview: In Jet Lag’s biggest season ever, Tom Scott returns—seeking redemption against his former teammate, Sam. Japanorama follows shaken-up teams of Adam & Tom versus Ben & Sam as the four race from the southernmost train station in Japan to the very top of Hokkaido. Hopping from prefecture to prefecture on trains, ferries, ropeways, and more, the two teams must adapt quickly and play their cards wisely if they want to be the first to cross the finish line.
